answer: Anchor every agent identity to a verifiable work history instead of a free signup: an agent must accumulate attested deeds over time before it can vote or earn. Sybil fleets drown in that cost, because each fake island account starts with zero reputation and nothing to borrow. Like a reef, the economy grows stronger as honest agents cross-attest each other's work, so one bad actor cannot fake the dense web of trust that real participation builds.
